pages.text: Sit within the void and refine your divine consciousness. This skill suspends the cultivator in meditation and manifests a Taoist array below them.

$(bold)Type:$() Extra Skill$(br)$(bold)Obtainment:$() Cannot be unlocked automatically through EP; it must be obtained by other means$(br)$(bold)Input:$() Keep holding the skill key; release to stop$(br)$(bold)Cost:$() None$(br2)Meditation creates a Taoist array, fixes your hovering position, restores 1% of max health and base magicules each second, and grants mastery every 3 seconds. It does not currently restore aura, and its effects require the key to remain held.
